experience_timeline.notes: Calculator: (1995-July 2025: 30 years 7 months) minus (Aug 2020-Nov 2023: 3 years 3 months) = 27 years 4 months

profile.summary: Senior technology leader with extensive years of IT infrastructure experience across Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Desktop in Data Center (DiDC), End User Computing (EUC), lifecycle management, performance engineering, and global escalation leadership across major financial institutions: Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, AIA, Edge Technology Group, and Merrill Lynch. Former VP & Asia Manager for Workspace Virtualization Engineering at Morgan Stanley, serving as the primary APAC escalation lead for VDI issues across APAC, EMEA, and NA. Architected global VDI blueprints supporting 120,000 desktops and authored 8 global white papers. Hands-on innovator with proven ability to build AI-powered automation tools, dashboards, and agentic systems, including an independently built production-grade algorithmic trading platform combining quantitative modeling, machine learning, multi-agent LLM orchestration, and live risk-managed exchange execution.

ai_projects.description: Built a production AI-powered interactive resume platform that enables real conversations about career experience instead of traditional resume scrolling. Dual LLM integration with intelligent conversational interface, responsive design, and production VPS deployment.

14 pre-built intelligent queries (cloud infrastructure, leadership, AI projects, cybersecurity, etc.)

Context-aware AI reasoning for accurate career narrative vs keyword-matching

ai_projects.title: Production Multi-Strategy Algorithmic Trading System
ai_projects.description: Architected and operate a live, multi-strategy crypto trading system (200+ commits since Jan 2026): a custom Python backtesting engine used to test dozens of strategy variants (regime-detection, hybrid, directional, funding-rate arbitrage), Hidden Markov / Hidden Semi-Markov Model (HMM/HSMM) market-regime classification, and LightGBM machine learning models for entry/exit signal generation.

ai_projects.title: Live Risk-Managed Multi-Account Execution Engine
ai_projects.description: Built a dedicated risk engine (position sizing, stop-loss/take-profit, trailing stops, volatility-based rules) wired to a live order-execution and position-management layer across multiple exchange accounts (Binance, Bitunix), deployed as a systemd-managed production service on a VPS with on-exchange safety-net orders and pre/post-deployment position audits.
ai_projects.impact: Applies enterprise-grade stop-loss and position-sizing discipline to a self-built, live, multi-account automated trading system with on-exchange safety nets.

ai_projects.title: Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Trading Research & QA
ai_projects.description: Designed a multi-agent architecture (Claude + DeepSeek ensemble) with specialized agents for market/news research, chart pattern recognition, technical analysis, backtest evaluation/grading, and automated QA/data-validation agents that gate deployment of dashboards and strategy changes.

ai_projects.title: Tavily Real-Time Search Integration for LLM Agents
ai_projects.description: Integrated the Tavily search API with the Anthropic SDK to give trading agents real-time web search for market news, crypto trends, and technical analysis context, using tool-calling to ground LLM outputs in current information.
